items.name: Experience

abilities.en: Experience is a core mechanic of Super Auto Pets, it allows pets to level-up and it's the main way Pets can improve their abilities.

items.notes: Exact opening definition from the dedicated wiki.gg Experience article.

items.name: Faint

abilities.en: Faint is an ability trigger that activates when a pet loses all of its hp.

items.notes: Exact opening definition from the dedicated wiki.gg Faint trigger article.

items.name: Hurt

abilities.en: Hurt is an ability trigger that activates when a pet receives damage.

items.notes: Exact opening definition from the dedicated wiki.gg Hurt trigger article. The article documents exceptions separately; this entry preserves only its general definition.

items.name: Toys

abilities.en: Toys are items that can benefit you both during battle and in the shop.

items.notes: Exact opening definition from the dedicated wiki.gg Toys article. This describes friendly Toys generally; Hard Mode Toys are a distinct category and are not used as the definition here.
